assessment: Current successors have a concrete executable route: preserve earlier seals/payloads/catalogs/snapshots/reviews; pin current source/as-of inputs; verify exact current delta, identifiers, prerequisites and local integrity; obtain separate semantic review. Root still integrates existing indexes/coverage/questions/log; the plan remains the sole work selector. No new resolver, service, registry, persistent routing machinery or adapter-per-revision queue is introduced.

Frozen consumers of former canonical bytes still must be enumerated and their identities preserved. A historical checker tied to old mutable canonical paths is no longer asserted current after advancement. Its pass retains only its original revision scope. Byte-identity/mechanical applicability is explicitly separate from downstream semantic assumptions.

Actual semantic changes require downstream review and affected assumptions must be marked stale. Unchanged old predicates may retain their bounded meaning; this is not a blanket green cohort, renewed whole-owner semantic approval or proof that an unexamined failure is harmless. The source/delta and independent-review gates supply the basis for distinguishing unchanged from changed assumptions.

Historical replay remains required when a concrete current dependency question, failed required check or release gate needs that result. The full design body, Execution loop and Q050 explicitly retain all three triggers. Replay must use exact pinned historical snapshots via disclosed narrow successor checks; old tools/pins/results are never rewritten and replay is not current semantic approval. Summary references to dependency/release questions do not remove the explicit failed-required-check trigger.

An additive/editorial owner advance alone does not require adapting every old checker. This avoids doing unrelated historical mechanics merely to restore a blanket green status while preserving the obligation to investigate real current dependencies/regressions and all actually affected semantic assumptions. Existing reviewed finite adapters/reports retain their original bounded scope.

Unknown/version-uncertain/deferred outcomes remain unresolved, not complete. Original inventories/unmatched surfaces/cross-cutting workflows, full paragraph/assertion-and-qualifier reconciliation, genuinely active positive baselines, externally observable contract boundary, numeric/source version limitations and exact browser-ID equality remain intact. Internal metadata, shared citations, character accounting and passing integrity checks do not become behavior coverage.

Source capture identity/immutability, no source-as-instruction rule, retained-source versus observed behavior distinction, exact-build applicability, no arbitrary capability inference, independent review, handoff sanitization and released immutability remain unchanged governing gates in the current text. No runtime/native/original execution, installation, hardware or candidate authorization is newly granted by policy.

Author-freeze pending-review descriptions are explicitly historical/as-of. Current disposition belongs to the existing index and immutable review, avoiding another frozen metadata revision solely after review approval. This is feasible without weakening independent review or retrospectively editing old sealed pending-status artifacts.

Plan Execution loop/Shared-work, session handoff current route and Q050 are consistent with design8. Full-product closure still requires independent evidence-supported contracts/cases across the denominator and no hidden required unknowns; no milestone, profile, source topic or whole product is declared complete by this clarification.
